items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
facts: Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 show improvements in areas like coding, reasoning, and vision.
They generate outputs up to 30% faster than Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1, and they’re available at a lower price: $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens.
Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 also come with an optional fast mode, which speeds up token generation by up to 2.5 times.

items.title: Google makes Gemini 4 Carbon generally available
facts: Today, we’re making Gemini 4 Carbon available to developers, enterprises, scientists, and consumers.
Carbon is our strongest model with frontier performance in cybersecurity capabilities and long-horizon agentic workflows across complex knowledge work, software engineering, and scientific reasoning.

Gemini 4 Carbon is available via the API in Google AI Studio and Gemini for business for all paying developers and enterprises, at the same introductory price as Gemini 4 Argon ($2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens).

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.321 makes Fable 5.2 the default Fable model
facts: Anthropic shipped Fable 5.2 yesterday. if you had Fable 5.1 saved, Claude Code already moved you onto it. at medium effort
Fable 5.2 is now the default Fable model in Claude Code: 1M context, $8 in and $40 out per million tokens, $0.20 for cache reads. it needs v2.1.321 or later

x_posts.author: @tidyowl
x_posts.text:
Anthropic shipped Fable 5.2 yesterday. if you had Fable 5.1 saved, Claude Code already moved you onto it. at medium effort

Fable 5.2 is now the default Fable model in Claude Code: 1M context, $8 in and $40 out per million tokens, $0.20 for cache reads. it needs v2.1.321 or later

Fable 5.1 started at high effort by default. Fable 5.2 starts at medium, unless you've picked a level for it

check what you're on:

/model

how the move actually works:

→ Pro, Max and Ultra: it happens the first time you open v2.1.321. the startup line can say (auto-updated), once
→ Team and Enterprise: it waits for your org's settings. it can land a session later, or never, and no line tells you
→ only the model saved in your user settings moves. project, local and managed settings keep Fable 5.1
→ Console accounts and third-party providers stay on Fable 5.1 too

three things that catch people:

> an old effortLevel "high" in your user settings kept Fable 5.1 at high. Fable 5.2 ignores it, same as Opus 5.5
> effort is calibrated per model. medium on 5.2 isn't medium on 5.1, so test before you compare
> in -p runs, Fable that bills to usage credits still gets billed without a prompt

Same alias. New model. New default.

the setup
> run /model and confirm which Fable you're on
> pick a level for 5.2 in /effort and press Enter, so it's saved for that model
> want 5.1 back for one repo? pin claude-fable-5-1 in that project's settings
> everywhere else: /model claude-fable-5-1

paste this into Claude Code ↓

"Check my model setup after the Fable 5.2 update:
1. Tell me which model and effort level this session runs on, and which setting each one comes from
2. List every settings file that sets model, effortLevel or modelSettings
3. Flag any effortLevel that no longer applies to Fable 5.2
4. Tell me which of my repos would still start on Fable 5.1
Show me every change as a diff first. Don't edit anything yet"

↳ http://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config

save it before your next long Fable…
